C0327.title: China's First Inactive SIM SMS Hijacking Case: Using Unactivated SIMs to Register Accounts
C0327.summary: On August 17, 2018, China's Ministry of Public Security reported that Guangxi and Hunan police had cracked the Changsha Xianshang Network Technology computer information system sabotage case. The company colluded with insiders at multiple telecom operators, used unissued and inactive phone numbers to connect to carrier servers and receive verification codes, then uploaded the numbers and codes to code-receiving platforms for card-dealer groups to register WeChat and other accounts in bulk; more than one million inactive numbers were confirmed as illegally used, and 15 people were placed under coercive measures.
